mapper.sql: CAST(m.account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId,m.username,m.nickname,m.bio,m.location,m.website, CAST(m.avatar_attachment_id AS CHAR) AS avatarAttachmentId,DATE_FORMAT(f.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS followedAt
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM forum_follow WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND followed_account_id=#{followedAccountId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_follow WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND followed_account_id=#{followedAccountId}
